purpose: Describe an action or state continuing at a past reference time.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
I was reading when the phone rang.
I lived near the sea as a child.
When I arrived, the shop was already closed.
restrictions: Depending on the verb, it may describe past progress, a habit, or a resulting state.
mistake: It does not always mean a single action was in progress.
